basic_information.name: Arthur Miller
basic_information.occupation_lifestyle: Retired carpenter, leads a sedentary lifestyle
basic_information.family_social_context: Widower, lives alone, has infrequent contact with his adult children

background: Arthur has been smoking for 50 years. He recently developed a persistent cough and his doctor has strongly advised him to quit.

main_issue.current_situation: Experiencing a persistent cough and shortness of breath
main_issue.why_it_matters: His health is declining and he wants to be around for his grandchildren

reasons_for_change: Wants to be healthier for his grandchildren
motivation.importance_of_change: He feels it is important but fears it might be too late

reasons_against_change: Smoking is his only remaining comfort
conflicting_goals: Wants to live longer vs. wants to keep his current coping mechanism

what_did_not_work: Cold turkey led to severe irritability

barriers: Fear that he is too old to see benefits
beliefs_and_concerns: Believes the damage is already done

social_environment.family_influence: Children are worried and push him to quit
social_environment.friends_and_peers: Most of his friends are also smokers
social_environment.living_situation: Lives alone in a quiet house
